objective: G18 with G17. The census of ticket B under the re-reading law of ticket A, and a census of one added not-all-equal knot with a fresh distinction on every start with at most two holders per distinction. Decide whether the law as stated makes any start gain a hidden excess, and which single births would. Stop when both censuses are done.
title: Does a birth that takes a shared distinction let growth finish a structure with a hidden excess?
